estimand: At same anchor and same probe batch: CE(candidate matched update)-CE(same-family coefficient0 matched update). Negative means lower CE. Each anchor analyzed separately.
step_control: Effective norm in concatenated unscaled LoRA BA and FC weight/bias coordinates matched to eta_ref=.02*g1.

metrics.current_local: Current-task test CE with own-task logits only.
metrics.current_allseen: Current-task test CE with all seen logits.
metrics.old_allseen: Equal-weight old-task mean CE with all seen logits.
metrics.old_local: Equal-weight old-task mean CE with own-task logits only.

limitations: Offline one-step counterfactuals at task-end checkpoints; no training update is committed.
33 probe batches and9 anchors are not independent seeds. All training seed2, diagnostic seed20260930.
Main means weight each recorded probe batch equally, including Task4 sizes128/128/128/42. Size-weighted sensitivity is a different estimand and reported separately.
Evaluation uses one fixed test batch per task rather than all test data.
Grid minima are exploratory on that test subset; no deployment coefficient is selected.
Matching rescales the whole direction. Family coefficients are not equivalent across families because a varies by anchor and batch.
Parameter-space orthogonality does not imply absence of interference with old tasks.
No full-training AAA/FAA improvement, universal coefficient or statistical significance follows from these diagnostics.
